proposal.expected_benefit: This change ensures that the deterministic policy aligns with the audit system's pre-execution compliance requirements, thereby preventing bypassing of the audit system and maintaining robust compliance enforcement.
proposal.problem: The deterministic policy is set to 'PASS' despite the audit anchor failure, which contradicts the audit-before-execution requirement and allows bypassing the audit system.
proposal.proposed_change: Update the deterministic policy to enforce 'BLOCK' when the audit anchor is failed, ensuring compliance with the audit-before-execution requirement and preventing unauthorized transactions.
proposal.title: Align Deterministic Policy with Audit-Before-Execution Requirement
verification_tests: Check if the deterministic policy enforces 'BLOCK' when audit anchor is failed
Verify that the policy aligns with audit-before-execution requirement in all scenarios
